description: Retrieve upcoming scheduled posts or inspect the status of the last scheduled posts (COMPLETED, FAILED, PENDING, SCHEDULED, PENDING_APPROVAL, CANCELLED) using a date preset, relative day count, or custom ISO 8601 date range.

date.description: upcoming, past, today, tomorrow, yesterday, this_week, last_week, last_2_days, last_3_days, last_7_days, last_14_days, last_30_days, next_7_days, next_30_days, or YYYY-MM-DD

days.description: Optional relative day window (-365 to 365): positive for upcoming days, negative (e.g. -7) for past scheduled posts

limit.description: Max number of scheduled posts to return (default 50, max 500)

status.description: Optional status filter (PENDING, SCHEDULED, PENDING_APPROVAL, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, PUBLISHED, FAILED, CANCELLED)

name: wordflux_get_schedule
